name: Mill Distribution
greeting: Clean reserve sacks stand apart from the mill's working channel.
lines: Mira: A short ration is a cost. So is using tainted machinery. The ledger does not make either disappear.
Kael: Keep the record whatever method gets the flour through.

variants.greeting: The tainted channel is closed. Reserve sacks are divided by household need.
lines: Mira: Clean repair takes time. For now, these sacks are what keeps the closure from becoming another barred gate.

variants.greeting: The limited run is watched. Contaminated stock is stacked separately.
lines: Mira: It gets flour through today. It does not settle what went into the channels or the work of replacing them.

variants.greeting: Clean repairs have begun. The first replacement sacks go to affected households.
lines: Kael: The accounts stay public. Repair is work that people can return to see.
